process.name: Synthetic Gmail search proof
process.objective: Run a synthetic label search that returns no conversations and verify the empty state without reading message content.
out_of_scope: Send, draft, label, archive, move, or delete mail
Inspect account identifiers or authentication state

inputs.name: synthetic-query
inputs.purpose: A synthetic Gmail label query selected to return no conversations.

outputs.name: empty-search-state
outputs.content: Verified generic Gmail empty-result state for the synthetic query.

outputs.name: validation-summary
outputs.content: Milestone outcomes only; no message content or account identifier.

milestones.intent: Reach Gmail's authenticated mailbox surface without inspecting messages.
preconditions: The operator has authenticated personally in the connected Chrome session.

actions.intent: Reset to the declared Gmail start state.
Wait until Gmail's search control is visible, enabled, and its application listeners have settled.

recovery: If Gmail shows authentication, hand the tab to the operator once and do not inspect the login page.
If the interface language differs, rediscover the localized search control and revalidate the capability.

milestones.intent: Submit the declared synthetic query through Gmail's search control.
preconditions: The synthetic query contains no account or message data.

actions.intent: Fill Gmail's search control with the synthetic query.

recovery: If Gmail normalizes the query route differently, verify the search control value and empty-state marker before changing the capability.

milestones.intent: Verify the synthetic label contains no conversations without reading the inbox.

actions.intent: Read only Gmail's generic empty-result marker.

success_evidence.value: There are no conversations with this label.

recovery: If the synthetic label unexpectedly exists, stop without opening any result and replace the query with another synthetic label before restarting validation.
If the interface language differs, rediscover only the generic empty-state marker and then repeat two clean runs.

evidence_to_record: Search control was found by semantic locator.

model_data: Gmail search-control role and accessible metadata
Generic empty-result state for a synthetic label

runs.start_state: Authenticated Gmail mailbox root in the connected Chrome session.
Authenticated Gmail mailbox root in the connected Chrome session.

known_limits: English Gmail accessible names and empty-state text were observed; other interface languages require rediscovery.
The proof covers search and state verification only, not message reading or download.
